findings.evidence: Original clause 1 survives in new boundary 'QuickLRU 实例 · 全部状态仅在内存中', components quick-lru/current-map/old-map, and the write card; this matches index.js:1-23. No persistent or remote store is implied.

Original clause 2 and all material old write/rotation edges survive in the first view note and '写入：先区分当前代是否已有键' card: current-key overwrite without #size increment; absent-from-current insert even if present in old; #size/maxSize whole-generation rotation; old generation eviction callback; fresh current Map; not one-item LRU. These are source-backed by index.js:68-77,120-132.

Original clauses 3-4 and the old current-get/old-get/promote/inspect/expired relationships survive in the second view note and '读取：只有有效的旧代 get 会晋升' card: current lookup precedes old; only a live old get removes from old and inserts into current; has/peek inspect both maps without promotion; missing or expired results are undefined/false. This matches index.js:40-65,105-118,137-157.

Original clause 5 and the old callback/delete/clear edges survive in the third view note and '删除：通知条件和计数各不相同' card: expiry compares with Date.now(), invokes optional onEviction before delete; delete affects both maps and decrements #size only when current deletion succeeds; clear empties both maps and resets #size; manual delete/clear do not call onEviction, while expiry/rotation can. This matches index.js:30-46,166-179.

The new graph preserves each material role/boundary from the old artifact (caller, QuickLRU controller, current and old Maps, expiry helper, optional caller callback, volatile in-memory instance). Its six high-level canvas edges retain caller API, both-map access, expiry, expiry callback, and rotation callback; all removed branch-level edge detail is retained in cards or view notes rather than lost.

All four eligible captures were inspected. At 1440x900 in light and dark, component names, sublabels, six short edge labels, boundary label, and navigation are readable at ordinary viewing; the main graph has clear whitespace and traceable paths. The detailed cards continue below the initial 1440px frame, which is normal page-level scrolling rather than clipped canvas content. At 2048x1320 in light and dark, the complete cards and graph are simultaneously readable with no observed overlap, truncation, or contrast failure.

summary: Post-study manual redesign passes source semantics, retention of material relationships from the old graph, and perceptual review. It is recorded as a redesign review only, not as a timed-trial result.
